senses.gloss: here is, behold. הִינָּם, הִינָּן behold, they are.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 5:6">Ned. V, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 48a:6">48ᵃ</cite>) <he>והי׳ לפניך אלא וכ׳</he> Bab. ed. (Mish. <he>ואינן</he>; Y. ed. <he>והן בפניך עד</he>) and behold they are before thee (thine), but only in order that my father &c.

senses.gloss: (introducing a question or exclamation) how?, indeed! Y. Shek. I, 45ᵈ bot. הן נקרא ולא וכ׳ can we, indeed, read this and not feel ashamed? (Bab. ed. הניקרא, marginal correct. Ms. M. הן נק׳).

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:2">B. Bath. VII, 2</cite> <he>הן חסר הן יתר</he> whether it be less (than a Beth Kor) or more.
B. Mets. 49ᵃ, v. הִין II Mekh. Yithro s. 4 answer על לאו לאו ועל הן הן no to a prohibition and yes to a positive command. Ib. s. 5 ה׳ וה׳ yes, indeed; a fr.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 11a:2">Ned. 11ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מכלל לאו אתה שומע הן</he> from the negative we derive the affirmative by implication; Y. ib. I, end, 37ᵃ, a. e. <he>ממשמע לאו וכ׳</he>.
